# E11 build plan

For senior review. No implementation greenlight is claimed. The frozen design remains unchanged. Both design reviews request changes; the r1 response is only partially accepted by r2 (`docs/tdd/reviews/E11.astra-r2.md:1`). Requests below must be filed and settled before their dependent bindings are implemented.

## Build order and connections

1. T1 builds pure urgency, classification, authority-result validation, inference decisions and canonical E11 ports/events.
2. After T1's local types are stable, T2 builds persistence and T3 builds pathway/request evaluation in parallel. T2 never calls a service; T3 never mutates urgency or creates a request.
3. T4 connects the producers, repository, shared evaluation/task mechanisms, effects and conditional urgency router, then proves the assembled HTTP and browser paths. One coder owns this safety-critical orchestration. Implementation defects return to their file owner with a failing test.

E01, E02, E15-core and E27-guidance are hard dependencies (`docs/SYSTEM.md:2338`). E10, E13, E26 and E31 add capability; unit work uses their published protocols and E01's kernel.testing, never a replacement module. A successful help, acting-authority or assistant acceptance scenario needs its real provider even though the provider is optional for station operation. E01 owns AnswerAccepted publication; E11 evaluates in its producer UOW. E15 handles UrgencyChanged in that same UOW. E26 help changes arrive through the durable outbox. External help/cancel delivery runs outside write transactions. E05 consumes RequestGatePort; E12 consumes PathwayQueries; neither read creates clinical effects.

At inspection hub/, ui/ and eval/ are absent. contracts/ and config/ contain only pharmacy artifacts. There is no docs/requests/E11.md. All existing docs/build/*/tasks.json ownership and every available design section 13 were checked. No other epic claims pathways. Coders must recheck because other planners are active. Owned production filenames come from `docs/tdd/E11.md:679`; new test subdirectories partition its hub/tests/pathways/** grant. No task owns UI, configuration, generated contracts, shared toolchain, eval, module registration or the engine.

## End-to-end evidence

T4 owns every row under hub/tests/pathways/e2e and drives the normal create_app(settings) composition root with real temporary SQLite, generated HTTP boundaries, authentication, grants, releases, audit, command ledger and events. Browser clauses use E21's Playwright driver against a running hub. Seed only through E21's explicit fixture profile and real input APIs. No hub dependency overrides, mocked safety services, direct-SQL scenario setup, skips or xfails. Documented external model/device fakes are permitted; absent providers cannot prove a successful provider path. Missing prerequisites block hand-in.

| Path and traces | What the complete test proves |
|---|---|
| Red flags and urgent entry: R15, V01/V61, D05/D15; T011/020 to 025/030/032 | Yes opens cached configured flow before network; unknown/declined stay recorded; red flags precede first model request. Model stopped, capture active, link down. First screen at most 500 ms p95. Kill hub, then remove client after answer commit: durable help association survives restart and converges with client entry. |
| First concerning reading: V03; T007 | Actual E01 accepted measurement through real E24 rule to E11 response/help, no repeat prerequisite. Remains blocked on the real producer/configuration; an injected Warning is insufficient. |
| Urgency lifecycle: R28, V04/V32; T001 to 010/013 to 017/060 | Acknowledge, review, normal repeat, help close, forecast and model cannot resolve. Current granted non-patient officer/acting officer records rationale without help/ground. Both signal/disposition interleavings, authority retirement/officer return, incapacitated crew, SQL-domain bypass and new cycle after real new symptom. |
| Delayed consequences and durability: V16; T019/023 to 026/061/064 | Original pins after question removal/remapping; button/other-episode/different-flow/closed help; disposition before effect/event/retry; multiweek matching replay creates no second answer/signal/session. Kill each command boundary, disk full, busy deadline and duplicate outbox/recovery retain exact accepted state. |
| Inference interruption: V27, R28; T027 to 031 | Real E13/E12 with documented external blocking/malformed model adapter. Cancel fails or times out while help still proceeds; stale guard independently prevents publication/application, including change after initial validation, ordinary material correction and two episodes with equal cycle numbers. UI reports incomplete/stale output. |
| Evidence: V24; T040 to 045 | Real E10 pinned release and E27 eligibility: superseded/withdrawn/missing/other-release and Earth-only material cannot authorize guidance in microgravity. Discrepancy visible. Mixed supporting uses cannot authorize whole-card instructions. Unreviewed eligible content has the Part A label; actual SIM-only content remains fenced. Accepted concern through get_pathway to real E05 proposal proves read-to-command separation. |
| Requests: R07, V17/V78, D06/D30; T045/050 to 053 | Orthostatic standing request denied in microgravity; real gap/review and form link. Camera pulse allowed with instrument, reason, decision_affected and heart region; ECG rejected before task/patient presentation, retained in handoff. Operator leaves, consent revoked, adapter down: revalidate; manual fallback actually captures through an aboard instrument; absent provider/unknown applicability never passes. |
| Privacy and origins: V26/V40; T012/062/063 | Distinct LIVE/SIM/REPLAY patients/missions; delayed events after mode change; cross-person refs and unshared officers rejected. Station/unrelated crew get only P0 broadcast. Journal/report canaries absent from events, logs, caches and approved ground projections; SIM sends no real external message. Real export/cache surfaces required, not vacuous empty outputs. |
| Configuration and current display: T065/070 to 073 | Safe label/hint edit changes served/rendered content without code; invalid activation retains last good release; open work stays pinned. Second client sees urgent review within registered refresh bound; offline/stale label and attribution remain truthful. No safety mapping edited. |
| Bounds, isolation and sites: T064/080 to 084, INV-06/07/08/09/12 | Permanent typed evaluator failure leaves real capture and pending fault, forbidden errors roll back. Clock jumps/mission boundary preserve relative retry versus absolute deadlines. Cancellation saturation, capacity overflow and exhausted retries fail loudly without lost accepted work. Two real disconnected hubs use local reachable kit/operators; imported old causes cannot rerun effects or overwrite home urgency. |

T1 owns domain properties and T001 to 019/029/031; T2 owns T060/061 and repository fault counterparts; T3 owns T040 to 044/050 to 053 and read-only T045/gate properties; T4 owns application, fault, performance and all complete end-to-end counterparts above. Every section 12 ID is retained, with corrected expectations above. Schema/parser/rule properties cover zero, negative, empty, maximum, nullable enums and changed unit/lot where quantities occur; E01/E32 retain clinical quantity validation. T080 to 084 measure design section 11 budgets and bounded memory; report reference hardware separately from deterministic tests.

Task gates use SYSTEM 6 and E01 section 15 command forms, explicitly selecting hub/pyproject.toml for pytest, ruff and mypy so root engine settings cannot mask failures. Gates do not run today because the hub toolchain/providers do not exist. C1 must extend the shared coverage, safety, mutation and trace inventories to E11 before those commands count as E11 evidence: at least 95 percent branch coverage independently per executable domain/application module, full safety condition outcomes, complexity at most 15, and reviewed critical mutants for urgency/red_flags/authority/inference_gate/request_gate. No aggregate coverage score or empty collection can pass. Final hand-in also requires full hub regression, CI, independent build review and AI-use entries.
